scope: Diagnose family previews that did not appear in the running Theme Lab and restore the direct-session GTK3 embedded route.

findings.gtk3: The native helper required IRIX_DOMAINOS_PRIVATE_NAMESPACE=bwrap, but the user-launched Theme Lab runs in the normal desktop session. Added a narrowly scoped private-workdir/Xauthority/display guard for GTK3 XEmbed and offscreen capture.
findings.gtk4: The route also requires a private namespace. Its current renderer rejects the saved all-controls catalog when unsupported controls are visible; the default selected arrow is outside the declared subset.
findings.qt5_qt6_plasma: Recipe generation exists, but the controller does not route these families into the central canvas. Their native preview is a separate-window path; the saved separate-preview option was false.
findings.gtk1: No installed GTK1 runtime or native gallery was confirmed.

changes.summary: Pass the private Theme Lab work directory to GTK3 preview/capture and validate its XEmbed/offscreen access before GTK initialization. Existing bwrap sessions keep their prior guard.

next: Keep GTK3 open for user comparison. Continue the central preview work one family at a time, starting with the GTK4 supported-control subset; then Qt5, Qt6, and Plasma Style. Do not claim those routes are embedded until each is observed inside the canvas.
